description:
I-Geozilla iwuhlelo lokusebenza lokwabelana ngendawo yomndeni nokuphepha olusiza imindeni namaqembu athembekile ukuthi ahlale eseduze, anolwazi, futhi esekelwe - kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kude kangakanani. Enezici ezihlakaniphile ezifana nokulandelelwa kwendawo ngesikhathi sangempela, izexwayiso zesimo esiphuthumayo, nemibiko yokushayela, i-Geozilla iletha ukuthula kwengqondo emindenini ekwazisa kokubili ukuphepha nokungafihli lutho.

✅ Isebenza kanjani:
1. Faka uhlelo lokusebenza bese unikeza imvume yokuthi indawo yakho yabiwe nombuthano wakho.
2. Dala noma joyina umbuthano womndeni oyimfihlo - yilabo kuphela obamemayo nabamukelayo abazofakwa.
3. Mema umndeni noma amalungu athembekile usebenzisa inombolo yocingo, isixhumanisi, noma ikhodi ye-QR.
4. Ilungu ngalinye elimenyiwe kufanele lamukele isimemo ngokusobala futhi linikeze zonke izimvume ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokuba ukwabelana ngendawo kuqale ukusebenza.
5. Wonke amalungu aziswa ngokucacile ngenjongo yohlelo lokusebenza, ukuthi ubani owamema, nokuthi idatha yendawo izosetshenziswa kanjani.
6. I-Geozilla ingasebenza kuphela uma umsebenzisi ngamunye evuma ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe. Uma noma yimuphi umuntu engavumi, ukwabelana ngendawo ngeke kunikwe amandla.

🌍 Izici ezibalulekile zokuphepha komndeni:
Ukwabelana Ngendawo Okubukhoma: Bona izindawo ze-GPS zesikhathi sangempela zomndeni wakho noma amalungu ombuthano athembekile.
Umlando Wendawo: Buka umugqa wesikhathi wokunyakaza womndeni wakho phakathi nosuku.
Ukufika Nezaziso Zokusuka: Misa izindawo ezivikelwe (njengekhaya, isikole, umsebenzi) ukuze uthole izexwayiso lapho othile efika noma ehamba.
Ukuqapha Ibhethri: Yaziswa uma ibhethri lefoni yothile liphela.
I-Safe Driving Insights: Siza ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha ngemibiko yokuziphatha yemikhuba yokushayela.
Isitholi se-AR.
Ukutholwa kokuphahlazeka Nezaziso ze-SOS.

I-Wear OS ehambisanayo: yazi ukuthi umndeni wakho ukuphi noma yabelana ngendawo yakho ngqo kusuka ku-smartwatch sakho.

🔒 Ubumfihlo, Ukungafihli kanye Nemvume Yabasebenzisi:
I-Geozilla isekela kuphela ukusetshenziswa okufanayo, ukwaziswa, nokungafihli kokwabelana ngendawo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezivumayo - njengamalungu omndeni noxhumana nabo abaseduze. Uhlelo lwethu lokusebenza lwakhelwe phezu kwezimiso zobumfihlo, ukuphepha, nokwethenjwa.
Zonke izici ze-Geozilla zincike ekubambeni iqhaza okucacile komsebenzisi nokuvunyelwa:
Akekho ongeza embuthanweni wakho ngaphandle kokwamukela kwakhe okusobala.
Ayikho idatha yendawo eyabiwa ngaphandle kwemvume esebenzayo yomsebenzisi.
Abasebenzisi abamenyiwe bayaziswa mayelana nokuthi ubani obamemile, injongo yohlelo lokusebenza, kanye nezimvume ezithile ezidingekayo.
Sikhuthaza abasebenzisi ukuthi basebenzise i-Geozilla kuphela ngokuphepha komndeni kanye nezimo zokusebenzisa ngokunakekela. Ukusebenzisa kabi uhlelo lokusebenza ukulandelela okungagunyaziwe noma ngaphandle kwemvume enolwazi kungqubuzana ngokuqinile nezinqubomgomo zethu nemithetho yobumfihlo yendawo.

📱 Izimvume Zohlelo Lokusebenza Zichaziwe:
Ukuze ilethe izici ezibalulekile zokuphepha, i-Geozilla ingase icele izimvume ezilandelayo (ngemvume yomsebenzisi esinyathelweni ngasinye):
Amasevisi Endawo (Njalo / Ukufinyelela Ingemuva): Kuyadingeka ukuze unike amandla ukulandelela kwe-GPS okuqhubekayo, izexwayiso ze-geofencing, nokutholwa kokuphahlazeka - ngisho noma uhlelo lokusebenza lungasetshenziswa.
Izaziso: Isetshenziselwa ukuletha izexwayiso ezibalulekile njengokufika/ukuhamba, i-SOS, ibhethri eliphansi, nomsebenzi wohlelo lokusebenza.
Oxhumana nabo: Ongakukhetha - kwenza kube lula ukumema abathintwayo abathembekile ngokukuvumela ukuthi ukhethe izinombolo zocingo encwadini yakho yamakheli.
Ikhamera Nezithombe: Isetshenziselwa ukusetha izithombe zephrofayela noma ukuskena izimemo ze-QR.
Ukunyakaza Nokufaneleka (Ukubonwa Komsebenzi): Kuthuthukisa imibiko yokushayela nokutholwa kokuphahlazeka ngokuqapha amaphethini okunyakaza.
Izimvume zicelwa ngokusobala futhi zichazwe kumongo. Abasebenzisi bahlala belawula ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi bangalungisa ukufinyelela kuzilungiselelo zedivayisi.

I-Geozilla izibophezele ebumfihlweni, ekukhanyeni, nasekusebenziseni isibopho. Asisekeli noma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokusebenza ngaphandle kolwazi nemvume yabo bonke ababambiqhaza.
I-Geozilla idizayinelwe futhi imakethwa kuphela ngamacala okusetshenziswa kokuphepha komndeni, njengabazali abalandelela izingane noma abanakekeli abasiza abondli. Ayisekeli ukulandelela okuyimfihlo, ukufakwa okuyimfihlo, noma ukwenza kusebenze ukude.
Uma udinga usizo noma unempendulo mayelana ne-Geozilla, xhumana nathi ku-: support@geozilla.com
